Bison Trails allows the user to run secure infrastructure on multiple blockchains.

The company's technology platform provides enterprise-grade security, multi-cloud and multi-region distribution, and a 99.99% uptime guarantee for node operators. Its aim is to strengthen the entire blockchain ecosystem, by providing a robust and secure infrastructure for the blockchain pioneers of tomorrow.

product.name: Coinbase Developer Platform
product.description: Provides developer tools and infrastructure for building onchain applications, including APIs and SDKs for seamless integration and scaling.

product.name: Base
product.description: An Ethereum Layer 2 solution offering secure, low-cost, and builder-friendly infrastructure for deploying EVM codebases and onramping users and assets.

product.name: Coinbase Onramp
product.description: A fiat-to-crypto onramp solution allowing users to buy or transfer digital assets with various payment methods and built-in KYC and compliance.

product.name: Staking
product.description: Enterprise-grade staking infrastructure supporting 15+ protocols, enabling secure staking without the need for running own validators.

product.name: Exchange API
product.description: APIs providing access to real-time market data and high-volume trading with features like deep liquidity, competitive fees, and insurance protection.

product.name: Sign In with Coinbase
product.description: A secure authentication method allowing users to log into apps using their Coinbase account, with API key authentication and permissioned actions.
